# `aitbc edge serve submit-request`

Submit a compute request to a GPU with model name and input data.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc edge serve submit-request [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--gpu-id` | text | — | yes | The Gpu id. |
| `--model-name` | text | — | yes | The Model name. |
| `--input-data` | text | — | yes | The Input data. |
| `--priority` | text | `normal` | no | Request priority |
| `--job-id` | text | — | no | Job ID for edge servers that verify escrow |
| `--escrow-id` | text | — | no | Legacy escrow ID for payment verification |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc edge serve submit-request --gpu-id <gpu_id> --model-name <model_name> --input-data <input_data>
```
